<div class="eyebrow dark">OUR APPROACH</div>
## Scientific knowledge and teacher education, in dialogue

At the **MACEDONIA Laboratory** of the Metropolitan University of Educational Sciences (UMCE, Chile) we bring together disciplinary research, chemical education and digital resources. We work with students, academics and collaborators to explore how science is built, communicated and learned.
:::

::: {.three-pillars}
::: {.pillar}
<div class="pillar-index">01 / INVESTIGATE</div>
### Chemistry and reactivity
Organic synthesis, free radicals, antioxidants, molecular modeling and computational chemistry.

[Explore our research areas →](research.qmd)
:::
::: {.pillar}
<div class="pillar-index">02 / TEACH</div>
### Chemical and science education
Teaching general chemistry, organic chemistry and science: laboratory learning, didactics and initial teacher education.

[Our purpose →](purpose.qmd)
:::
::: {.pillar}
<div class="pillar-index">03 / INNOVATE</div>
### Resources for learning
Simulations, 3D printing and digital technologies with a pedagogical purpose.

[Explore educational resources →](resources.qmd)
:::
:::
